resources.string: Source: the readings stored by Apex on this phone
Export and import are off in Demo mode
Demo mode uses synthetic data in a separate store. It never leaves the app, and a file can never be loaded into it. Leave Demo mode in Settings to use these.
Save a copy of your readings to a file you choose. Each row keeps its source label, so you can always see where a value came from.
This file contains your health data and is not encrypted. It is yours to keep safe: anyone who has the file can read it. Apex does not send it anywhere.
Not included: sign-in details, keys and settings.
One file. Can be imported back into Apex.
One spreadsheet file per kind of reading, in a ZIP. For other tools.
Keep this screen open if you can. Large histories take a little while.
%1$s rows were left out because a value was not a valid number.
There was nothing to export yet.
Load an Apex JSON export back into this phone. Rows keep the source they had. Computed scores are not imported: Apex recalculates them from the readings.
Importing the same file twice gives the same result.
%1$s rows read so far. Apex then recalculates your scores.
Your readings were added and your scores were recalculated.
The file ended or was damaged part-way. Everything before that point was imported and recalculated. Export again from the original phone to get the rest.
This file is not an Apex JSON export, so nothing was imported. Choose a file made by Export as JSON. A CSV ZIP cannot be imported.
Made by a newer version of Apex
This file uses a format this version does not understand, so nothing was imported. Update Apex and try again.
Set-aside rows were damaged, from an unknown source or not importable. Their content is not kept. %1$s of them are computed values, which Apex recalculates itself.
This is not available in Demo mode.
The file could not be opened. Pick it again, or choose another place.
Something went wrong while reading or writing the file. A partly written file may remain: delete it and try again.
Remove everything Apex keeps on this phone and return to the start. This cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy.
Background sync and alerts are stopped.
Apex\'s access to your Google account is revoked at Google, and the sign-in details on this phone are erased.
Health Connect sync positions on this phone are erased.
Your saved Coach key, if you added one.
The record of alerts already sent.
All readings, scores, check-ins and manual workouts in the encrypted database.

Nothing in Health Connect and nothing in your Google account is deleted. Apex only reads from them. To remove that data, open Health Connect, then Data and access, and delete it there. For your Google account, use the Google Health or Fitbit data controls in your account settings. You can also remove Apex under Apps and access in your Google account.
Delete everything Apex keeps on this phone?
Your readings, scores, check-ins, manual workouts, settings and profile will be erased and you will return to the start. This cannot be undone.
This keeps going even if you leave this screen. Apex returns to the start when it finishes.
These steps failed. Everything else was removed. Try again, or clear Apex\'s storage in Android settings.
Apex is returning to the start.
